status_note: Reproduces on 12.0.0 with pandas 3.1.0 and 3.1.1, and on Ibis main (f73d329, 2026-11-02).
summary: Ibis reads the deprecated `pd.options.future.infer_string` in `PandasType.from_ibis` (`ibis/formats/pandas.py:60`), so every `execute()` warns `Pandas4Warning: The 'future.infer_string' option is deprecated` under pandas 3.1, also for a scalar with no string in it.
handling: The checks on data fetch their counts through Arrow (`_count` in `contracts.py`: `to_pyarrow().as_py()`), so users see no warning ([#479](https://github.com/AlexanderNenninger/substrait-lean/issues/479)). The tests still ignore the message (`filterwarnings` in `python/pyproject.toml`).
